profile_text.body:
The Machine Intelligence Research Institute (MIRI) is a nonprofit founded in 2000 and headquartered in Berkeley, California, United States. According to its website, it focuses on preventing human extinction from artificial superintelligence. The organization says it has worked for over two decades to understand and prepare for challenges it expects humanity to face during a transition to a world with artificial superintelligence, and that its technical and philosophical work helped found the field of AI alignment, with its researchers originating many theories and concepts it says are central to current discussions of AI.

MIRI states that recent rapid advances at the frontier of artificial intelligence have dramatically shortened estimates of when superintelligence will arrive, that technical progress on safety, alignment, and control has failed to keep up, and that humanity does not understand the internal workings of present systems well enough to completely control them or robustly steer their behaviors, let alone more powerful systems it expects in coming years.

The record lists no products, no lawsuits, and no MCP servers for the organization.
